notes: Hand-verified against the sources (P03-08). The relations were written down from the source before the first run and matched it unchanged.
relations: `<type> <from> -> <to>`; L2 heuristics, so every edge is inferred. references are one edge per (from, to); calls one per call site.

Function scopes: total's local `tax` shadows the function (no reference); the lambda parameter `tax` in decorated is local; `global RATE` in counter makes both uses of RATE refer to the module variable.
The default value `rate=RATE` of discount is evaluated outside the function body and is a reference from discount (its range includes the parameter list).
scaled(tax=tax): the default value is the module function tax (a reference), while `tax(1)` in the body calls the parameter (no calls edge).
The decorator @decorate lies outside the extracted range of decorated (which starts at `def`), so it is a reference from the module.
outer's call `inner()` is not recorded: inner is a name local to outer (a known L2 gap; the call is not a workspace module-scope name).
Not recorded by design: pricing.discount(1) (an attribute call on a module), self.check() and cart.checkout() (attribute calls), len (a builtin).
Known gap: `from shop.pricing import total as sum_up` binds the alias sum_up, but import drafts keep only the exported name `total`, so the call sum_up(items) in total_of is not recorded.
